This case has gone to a person. No runbook covers `loyalty-points`, so nothing says whether this exception is expected or what may be fixed without one.

The error is a `System.OverflowException` in `OrderApi.GetLoyaltyPoints` (src/OrderService/Api/LoyaltyPoints.cs, line 9), where a decimal value is converted to Int32 for order 1008 and falls outside the Int32 range. I haven't looked at the code or the data, so I don't know whether the fault is in the data or the code. The case is written up at `demos/louis-agent/data/triage/people/eval-loyalty-points-1008.md`.
